verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Sift pooling signals across merchants (a consortium or global network) to inform an individual merchant's score. The closest item, sift-docs-4, says Sift 'gets smarter the more data it has about your business', which is per-merchant learning. A community comment calling Sift an 'aggregator' is a privacy concern, not documentation of cross-merchant scoring. The axis clearly applies to a fraud-scoring product, so lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a founder, scoring benefits from a cross-merchant network — a card or identity seen across thousands of other businesses informs the risk decision on mine
